# Home Stratosphere

> > Home Stratosphere is a comprehensive home design resource offering free interactive design tools, printables, and architectural inspiration.

Published by JGD Media Group in North Vancouver, BC, Canada, Home Stratosphere provides homeowners and design enthusiasts with practical tools including paint visualizers featuring Benjamin Moore and Sherwin-Williams colors, floor plan creators, and extensive galleries of interior design ideas and architectural styles.

## Key Topics

- Interior Design
- Paint Visualization
- House Plans & Floor Plans
- Home Design Tools
- Curb Appeal
- Architecture Styles
- Benjamin Moore Colors
- Sherwin-Williams Colors
- Room Design
- Free Printables
- Floor Plan Creator
- Design Software
- Home Improvement
- Residential Architecture

## Design Tools & Software

- [Free Online Paint Visualizer Software (Interior Rooms & House Exteriors)](https://www.homestratosphere.com/paint-visualizer/): Free paint visualization tool with Benjamin Moore & Sherwin-Williams

## Free Resources

- [Printables (Free)](https://www.homestratosphere.com/printables/): Free downloadable printables and design resources for personal use
